# Woodux

> Woodux is a free library of 40 woodworking, outbuilding, workshop-setup, and self-sufficiency guides. Where relevant, articles link to real external retailers, plan publishers, and course providers — not products Woodux sells itself.

## Resources we recommend (not affiliate links currently)

- [ShopWoodworking.com](https://www.shopwoodworking.com/): editorially checked project plans and books, from Popular Woodworking's publisher.
- [Rockler](https://www.rockler.com/): a large, long-established woodworking tool and hardware retailer.
- [Woodworkers Guild of America](https://www.wwgoa.com/): structured, project-based video courses.
- [KC Tool](https://www.kctool.com/): a German hand-tool importer (Knipex, Wera, Stahlwille).

None of these are currently affiliate relationships. If that changes for a given company, the disclosure on the relevant page will say so.

## All Guides

See [the full guides index](https://woodux.online/articles/index.html) for all 40 free guides, grouped into: Beginner Projects & Skills, Plans & Cut Lists, Sheds & Outbuildings, Workshop Setup, Power Tools & Buying Guides, Homestead & Self-Sufficiency, Furniture & Materials, and General Woodworking Questions.

## Disclosure

Woodux does not sell products directly. Outbound links go to external companies we think are worth a visit, and none of them are currently paying Woodux a commission.
